title: Complement of the majority threshold probe
statement: Let $0<\epsilon<1/4$, and define the composed majority threshold probe by $T(\epsilon)=(\sqrt{\epsilon}+1/2)/2$. Then $1-T(\epsilon)$ lies strictly between $1/2$ and $1$.
